propositions: git stash operations in the tickets worktree pop stashes from the shared repo-global stack, potentially applying stashes created in unrelated source worktrees
a stash pop from another branch can leave the index with unmerged entries for non-reconciler files (source paths, config), stranding every store write
the tickets worktree must not be mutated through direct git operations (stash, add, commit, merge, push); all mutations must route through rebar's event append API
the auto-heal path must distinguish foreign paths (not tracked on tickets branch, not ticket-shaped) from genuine unmerged ticket data, discarding foreign and refusing on ticket conflicts
a supported maintenance entrypoint must exist with backup ref before first write, refusal when unpushed commits exist, and durable audit record for raw-git operations
a break-glass override with explicit written reason is required for edge cases the supported entrypoint cannot cover
